meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通读所有开放 issue 和评论，按根因分组；每组开一个主 issue 并写设计文档，用统一评论关闭子 issue，再按组准备一个一次性关闭整组的修复 PR。新 bug 会并入已有计划。
howto.when: 当仓库有 20 个以上开放 issue 且很多像是同一缺陷的不同症状，或你要求对 issue 做聚类、去重或建计划，或想确认新 bug 是否已在某计划中时触发。

say.text: 请把仓库所有开放 issue 按根因聚类，并为每一类建一个计划主 issue。
新提交的 bug #42 是否属于某个现有计划？请分诊并处理。

howto.what_en: Claude groups all open issues/comments by root cause, opens a plan-master + doc per cluster, closes children with a standard comment, and bundles one PR per cluster; new bugs fold into existing plans.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo has 20+ open issues sharing root causes, when asked to cluster/dedupe/plan the backlog, or when a new bug should be checked against existing plans.

say_en.text: Cluster all open issues by root cause and open one plan-master per cluster.
say_en.note: Claude reads issues, creates masters, closes children.

say_en.text: Does new bug #42 belong to an existing plan? Triage it.
say_en.note: Claude matches a master, logs child, closes it.

say_en.text: Bundle plan-02 children into one fix PR that closes them on merge.
say_en.note: Claude writes the PR with Closes #N and a CI test matrix.
